action.mutates: starts transient units p8test-xrdp3389 and p8test-xrdp3390 (python3 -m http.server on 0.0.0.0); inserts at the top of INPUT an accept for related/established traffic and one for TCP 22 (as the base firewall has), then sets the IPv4 INPUT policy to DROP, until the next revert
two connection attempts from the peer to the class node (TCP 3389, TCP 3390); results in /run/p8test-xrdp/reach.txt on the peer

starts transient units p8test-vnc5900 and p8test-vnc5901 (python3 -m http.server on ::1), sets the IPv6 INPUT policy to DROP until the next revert, and makes one connection to each; the outcomes go to /run/p8test-xrdp/vnc.txt

outcomes.outcome: the three rules are in place (IPv4 3389 accept; IPv6 lo 5900 accept; IPv6 established replies from 5900 accepted)
under an IPv4 INPUT drop, another host reaches port 3389 while a port no rule opens stays dropped
under an IPv6 INPUT drop, a connection over IPv6 loopback reaches VNC's port 5900 (and gets its replies), while another loopback port stays dropped
